import { BaseSubgraph as Base } from "@powerhousedao/reactor-api";
import { gql } from "graphql-tag";

export class InlineSubgraph extends Base {
  name = "inline";
  readonly label = "today";
  typeDefs = gql`
    scalar Date
    enum Choice { YES NO }
    interface Node { id: ID! }
    type Item implements Node { id: ID! }
    type Query { item: Node, date: Date }
    type Updates { item: Item }
    schema { query: Query, subscription: Updates }
  `;
  resolvers = {
    Date: { serialize: (value: unknown) => value },
    Choice: { YES: "yes", NO: "no" },
    Node: { __resolveType: () => "Item" },
    Item: { __isTypeOf: function(this: { valid: boolean }) { return this.valid; } },
    Query: { item: () => ({ id: "1" }), date: () => this.label },
    Updates: { item: { subscribe: async function* () { yield { id: "1" }; }, resolve: (value: unknown) => value } },
  };
  hasSubscriptions = true;
}
